goal: Overhaul sepsis pipeline: remove optimistic validation leakage, run robust cohort-level validation, regenerate comparative visuals (including 3D GNN graph, heatmaps, SHAP), and update poster + engineering notebook.

messages.body: Required implementation changes: fold-internal feature selection for both hybrid and baselines; add Leave-One-Dataset-Out CV track and threshold calibration from train folds only; rebuild plots and docs from new JSON schema.

Initial audit complete: optimistic CV likely from pre-CV global feature selection (MAD top-2000 before fold split). Secondary risk: sample-level SGKF can overstate cohort generalization relative to leave-one-dataset-out.

Mission complete. Outputs regenerated with robust validation and expanded visualization package. Residual risk: hybrid model does not beat strongest tabular baseline on pooled CV AUROC; claim language updated to stay evidence-bounded.

I1.acceptance: CV protocol updated; results regenerate without near-perfect leakage signatures
I1.summary: Training/evaluation pipeline rebuilt for robust CV: fold-internal feature selection, LODO support, threshold calibration, normalization persistence.
I1.title: Implement fold-safe feature selection and cohort-aware validation

I2.acceptance: All requested visual types produced in publication folders
I2.summary: Generated comprehensive comparison visuals including ROC/PR overlays, metric heatmaps, relation-attention heatmap, and 3D GNN topology plot.
I2.title: Generate model-by-model comparative visuals, heatmaps, and 3D GNN topology

I3.acceptance: SHAP artifacts and summaries generated and linked into reports
I3.summary: Added SHAP explainability workflow and artifacts (summary bar, heatmap, top-feature table, JSON summary).
I3.title: Add SHAP analysis and biomarker explainability outputs

I4.acceptance: Poster + engineering notebook regenerated using new results and file manifest
I4.summary: Poster and engineering notebook regenerated from robust outputs; detailed execution trace captured in overhaul_execution_log.md and included in notebook TeX.
I4.title: Update poster and engineering notebook with full execution trace

R1.acceptance: Leakage vectors documented and mitigation encoded in train/eval design
R1.summary: Leakage vectors documented: global pre-CV feature selection and split protocol weakness. Mitigations implemented via fold-internal selection + LODO mode.
R1.title: Diagnose overfitting/leakage and define robust validation protocol

V1.acceptance: Independent checks confirm metrics and claim language are aligned with outputs
V1.summary: Validated regenerated metrics and checks. Robust CV no longer shows near-perfect saturation, but strongest tabular baseline remains ahead on pooled CV AUROC.
V1.title: Verify robustness claims and baseline comparisons

V2.acceptance: No stale metric text or missing files in publication artifacts
V2.summary: Verified required artifacts exist in results, figures, poster package, and notebook outputs.
V2.title: Verify regenerated poster/notebook/figure manifests reference current outputs
